description: Lucent's logo: a dark rounded square (about #18252B) holding a two-tone "L" (a teal vertical stroke, about #ABD7CF, and a pale foot, about #E3F1EC, meeting at a 45-degree mitre) on a transparent background. A 1254 x 1254 pixel, 8-bit RGBA PNG.
supplied_by: Fan Zhu, Lucent's project owner, as the application's logo

origin.content_credentials: A C2PA manifest (C2PA 2.2) in the PNG's caBX chunk (21,881 bytes), kept in the committed master: claim generator "OpenAI Media Service API"; actions c2pa.created (ChatGPT, gpt-image), c2pa.converted and c2pa.watermarked.unbound; signed by "OpenAI Media Service" (OpenAI OpCo, LLC; certificate issued by Trufo C2PA Claim Signing CA (2025)) with a time stamp of 2026-10-10T17:48:31Z. Read from the manifest's text; the signature was not validated (Lucent's tools include no C2PA validator).

modifications: None: the master is the supplied file, byte for byte. Every other image of this folder is generated from it by tools/branding/Update-Branding.ps1.
